title: C. Jon Snow and his Favourite Number

legend: Jon Snow now has to fight with White Walkers. He has n rangers, each of which has his own strength. Also Jon Snow has his favourite number x. Each ranger can fight with a white walker only if the strength of the white walker equals his strength. He however thinks that his rangers are weak and need to improve. Jon now thinks that if he takes the bitwise XOR of strengths of some of rangers with his favourite number x, he might get soldiers of high strength. So, he decided to do the following operation k times:
Arrange all the rangers in a straight line in the order of increasing strengths.
Take the bitwise XOR (is written as ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png)) of the strength of each alternate ranger with x and update it's strength.
The strength of first ranger is updated to ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b989fec42185029adec488aa738b78d9de953aef.png), i.e. 7.
The strength of second ranger remains the same, i.e. 7.
The strength of third ranger is updated to ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3c7c9436158c0744fffbc90f5dcf6769683b82c2.png), i.e. 11.
The strength of fourth ranger remains the same, i.e. 11.
The strength of fifth ranger is updated to ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/842bb4d07e058ad06611d99fc15455f0a936cb03.png), i.e. 13.
Now, Jon wants to know the maximum and minimum strength of the rangers after performing the above operations k times. He wants your help for this task. Can you help him?
input: First line consists of three integers n, k, x (1 ≤ n ≤ 105, 0 ≤ k ≤ 105, 0 ≤ x ≤ 103) — number of rangers Jon has, the number of times Jon will carry out the operation and Jon's favourite number respectively.
Second line consists of n integers representing the strengths of the rangers a1, a2, ..., an (0 ≤ ai ≤ 103).
output: Output two integers, the maximum and the minimum strength of the rangers after performing the operation k times.

legend.ai: 琼恩·雪诺现在必须与异鬼战斗。他有 n 名游骑兵，每名游骑兵都有自己的战斗力。此外，琼恩·雪诺还有他最喜欢的数字 x。每名游骑兵只有在异鬼的战斗力与自己的战斗力相等时，才能与异鬼战斗。然而，他认为自己的游骑兵太弱了，需要提升实力。琼恩现在想到，如果将一些游骑兵的战斗力与他最喜欢的数字 x 进行按位异或，或许能得到战斗力更强的士兵。因此，他决定执行以下操作 k 次：
按照战斗力递增的顺序，将所有游骑兵排成一条直线。
将每隔一名游骑兵的战斗力与 x 进行按位异或(记作 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png))，并更新其战斗力。
第一名游骑兵的战斗力更新为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b989fec42185029adec488aa738b78d9de953aef.png)，即 7。
第二名游骑兵的战斗力保持不变，即 7。
第三个游骑兵的战斗力更新为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3c7c9436158c0744fffbc90f5dcf6769683b82c2.png)，即 11。
第四个游骑兵的战斗力保持不变，即 11。
第五个游骑兵的战斗力更新为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/842bb4d07e058ad06611d99fc15455f0a936cb03.png)，即 13。
现在，Jon 想知道执行上述操作 k 次后游骑兵战斗力的最大值和最小值。他希望你帮助完成这项任务。你能帮他吗？

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 n、k、x（1 ≤ n ≤ 105，0 ≤ k ≤ 105，0 ≤ x ≤ 103）——Jon 拥有的游骑兵数量、Jon 将执行该操作的次数以及 Jon 最喜欢的数字。
第二行包含 n 个整数，表示游骑兵的战斗力 a1、a2、...、an（0 ≤ ai ≤ 103）。

output.ai: 输出两个整数，表示执行 k 次操作后游骑兵的最大战斗力和最小战斗力。
